tree.heading: General authority
tree.text: The Secretary is authorized to award grants to Indian tribes for the purpose of developing and implementing plans for the investment of Indian tribal trust funds.

tree.heading: Use of funds
tree.text: The purposes for which funds provided under this section may be used include (but are not limited to)—

children.text: the training and education of employees responsible for monitoring the investment of trust funds;
the building of tribal capacity for the investment and management of trust funds;
the development of a comprehensive tribal investment plan;
the implementation and management of tribal trust fund investment plans; and
such other purposes related to this subchapter that the Secretary deems appropriate.
